vb_textbox.text:
As each gnome appears, tap S for the left gnome or K for the right. Then hit space when you see the basket. You have 1.5 seconds to hit the button each time. Nothing will happen if you hit the wrong button or hit too early, though if you hit too late you can time out. You will see a multiplier on some rounds. 
It helps to keep your fingers on the keys as you play the game. It can make it easier to just use your dominant hand, as there is no obvious difference between the gnomes. If you find yourself slowing down or getting distracted, use your non-dominant hand to wake up your brain. If you are neurodiverse, you may find it helpful to have audio playing to help you focus; do not eat or do other activities involving your hands during gameplay as you may miss a cue.
